task_premise_adjudicated.finding: The instruction 'every worker must execute multiple times a day or be merged/consolidated' was ALREADY evaluated and rejected by the fleet's own queue, with data.
task_premise_adjudicated.issue_736_WONTFIX: WORKER-PRODUCTIVITY-CONSOLIDATION. Rationale: 'The multiple-times-per-day test is the wrong test for this fleet. Measured req24 vs expected24 for all 40 scheduled workers: req24 range 1..1663; 35 of 40 have req24 >= 3; 38 of 40 have req24 >= expected24. Zero scheduled workers fail to execute. The 15 workers without crons are pull-based services and apps by design, not idle workers - qnfo-gateway alone serves 157,988 req/30d, the highest traffic in the fleet.'
task_premise_adjudicated.issue_728_WONTFIX: STALE-WORKER-CONSOLIDATION. Rationale: '45/55 workers unprobed conflates two different things: (a) the service-binding health probe in fleet_status reaches 12 of 55, and (b) the dashboard tracks 40 scheduled workers with live req24. The 43 unprobed figure counts pull-based services that have no /health-by-binding path, not dead workers.'
